column1: # Login-stage opcodes of revision 910: the first byte on a new connection.
# Fields: name, opcode, size. Size is a byte count for a fixed payload, var-byte (one length byte follows the opcode) or var-short (a big-endian u16 length follows).
# Sorted by opcode. Opcodes nothing sends or handles are named UNUSED_<opcode> (client) and UNHANDLED_<opcode> (server).
